facts.fact: Gemma 偷看了初见全程，滑进座位就起哄「你请了全校最可爱的家教」。
facts.anchor: I think you have the cutest tutor ever!

facts.fact: Eden 对 Gemma 划界：我们的关系必须严格职业，不许暧昧。
facts.anchor: our relationship has to be strictly professional

facts.fact: Oliver 的短信：本周只是课程介绍，但也许先读本书是个好开始，末尾带眨眼表情。
facts.anchor: But maybe reading a book would be a good start ;)

facts.fact: Gemma 解读荐书行为：他在试水，看你吃不吃言情这一套。
Eden 读完被安利的书后吐槽：无法理解怎么会有人写没有情节的书。
facts.anchor: I fail to understand how one can write a book with no plot.

facts.fact: 图书馆争吵中 Oliver 反问：是你雇的我，想及格就还得雇我。
facts.anchor: You literally hired me! And you certainly will if you want to pass!

facts.fact: 争吵让两人逼近：她数得清他鼻梁上的雀斑，甚至冒出「伸手就能吻」的念头。
facts.anchor: He’s so close that I can make out a smattering of freckles across his nose.

facts.fact: 辅导收尾：Oliver 挤出僵硬的笑、头也不回地走了，她承认这很刺痛。
facts.anchor: He gives me a tight smile and then walks away without a backwards glance.
